episode.showDescription: The official podcast of comedian Joe Rogan.
episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

transcript_window.text: And some of these people were just grinding it out.
And, you know, my friend Dedrick Flynn, he was out in Atlanta doing it.
And my friend Ari Matty was in Estonia.
And he went to Australia for 10 years.
to make it in comedy, gets on Kill Tony, boom, now he has a career.
It's incredible.
And I don't recognize those names, but as me, a case study, if they're doing stuff in Estonia or other, I never would see it, but if they're on Kill Tony, I'll see it.
Exactly.
And there are millions of people like me that we're not, we're casual comedy watchers.
Maybe I'll watch a Netflix special here or there, and I watch Kill Tony.
And so if you don't exist in one of those two things, you just don't exist in my world.
And there's so many people like me.
There's a lot of people now like that, particularly.
Particularly.
And we wanted to set up a network.
We wanted to set up like a real pathway where these people can, you can see, hey, other people like Cam Patterson.
He was a doorman at the comedy store and now he's on Saturday Night Live or doorman at the mothership rather.
And now he's on Saturday Night Live.
He started out at the mothership and he's working there as an employee.
And he's funny and I know who he is.
He's amazing.
Because killed Tony.

Exactly.
But there's multiple versions of that now that are coming out of the club.
And so we wanted to set it up like that.
